observations: The original palette broadly matches the reference silhouette and paint positions, but its edge and color boundaries are soft.
A partial thin wood rim makes the lower/left palette edge clearer, leaving the original upper-right grip and fingers free.
Six shallow, mildly irregular real paint volumes clarify the existing coral, blue, mint and gold spots without editing the bitmap.
The ferrule coating now follows 68 exact selected source triangles; no inferred cylinder axis is used. Front and both quarter views show a warmer, more distinct metal region at the original neck.
Actual left/right profiles verify that the displaced/double sleeve seen in V3 is gone. The source brush silhouette and depth are retained apart from the thin surface coating.
The original curved paint tip, grip region, fingers, body, hair, face and clothing/back artifacts remain unchanged. This does not certify a true thumb hole or a perfect whole character.
limits: Inspected local improvement only; no exact reference camera-registration or whole-character approval.
Rim/paint/ferrule physical relief and metallic response are manual construction.
Each added solid is topologically closed and consistently oriented; intentional source-accessory contact is not a global intersection certificate.
